rationale: Prevent recurrence of parseable frame-event poison by validating every frame event before it is appended, without changing non-frame ledgers or repairing live method-state.
target_metrics: malformed frame lifecycle events are rejected before append
failed malformed frame-event writes leave the frame file byte-for-byte unchanged
valid frame lifecycle events and non-frame control ledger writes continue to work
existing candidate Skill tests pass unchanged
rollback_triggers: any regression in existing Skill test scripts
any valid lifecycle sequence rejected before close solely because it is an allowed intermediate state
any non-frame ledger write blocked by frame-event validation
